title: Resolving Inconsistent Semantics in Multi-Dataset Image Segmentation
mechanism: Trains one segmentation model on several datasets whose class definitions conflict, by reconciling label semantics instead of forcing one label space.
adaptation: Map UCF-EL, MultiSolSegment and PVEL-S classes onto our 24 classes with per-dataset label spaces, for joint training and for the benchmark's cross-dataset track.
min_experiment: Arm = joint training with per-dataset label spaces versus house PF. Metrics: mIoU_rob and E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 and E1 is n.d.
prior_overlap: joint multi-dataset training is open in BRIEF section 5

alt_notes.adaptation: Map UCF-EL, MultiSolSegment and PVEL-S label spaces onto our 24 classes with label-space-specific queries; use for joint training and for a cross-dataset benchmark track.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: joint training with label-space queries (needs a mask-classification decoder) vs house PF; metric E1 relF1@2 and clean-49 mIoU_rob; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
